title: 3. Apprehending and applying Christ with all his merits vnto himselfe.

segments.text: But as many as receiued him, to them he gaue power, to bee the sonnes of God, to them that beleeue in his name. And Iesus said vnto them, I am the bread of life, hee that commeth to me shall not hunger: and he that beleeueth in me shall neuer thirst.
